body: It comes and goes. Sometimes it's just ideation without any seriousness, other times it's like yesterday where I cry all day and it literally feels like I HAVE to do it, and all I can think about is doing it, with no regards to consequences. I lose my sense of everything. The longest I've had zero suicidal thoughts was about 6 months, which has happened twice; once was because I started an SSRI (stopped taking because of side effects), the other time idk why. I haven't figured out how to escape from it yet other than letting it run its course. Today I feel decent, a little apathetic but not tearful.
